AUTH-UI-080.sub_module: Forgot password – full reset by email
AUTH-UI-080.scenario: Verify that a user can reset the password using the code or link sent by email and then sign in with the new password
AUTH-UI-080.preconditions: A valid admin account exists and its mailbox can be read. Location access is allowed in the browser. This check runs only once: if the password has already been reset and saved, it is skipped.
steps: Enter the admin email and click Send reset link.
Open the newest password-reset email and follow its link, or enter the code from the email and click Verify.
Type a new password in the New password and Confirm password fields and save it.
Go to the sign-in page and sign in with the admin email and the new password.
Enter the one-time code sent by email and click Verify and sign in.
AUTH-UI-080.test_data: Email: admin account email / New password: the configured reset password, or a generated one like 'Escrow@12345' (upper, lower, digit, symbol)
AUTH-UI-080.expected: The password is reset, sign-in with the new password succeeds, the user leaves the sign-in page and the Dashboard menu is available.
